properties.basis: Nile valley + Delta; southern edge at Aswan/Dodecaschoenus: 'about 120 kilometres from Syene (Aswan) to Hiera Sycaminos (Muharraqa). It had belonged to the Ptolemies' (GHA II ch.7 p.208); Nubian threat p.184. Draft's pp.189–190 had no matching text; corrected.

sources.citation: H. Riad (with J. Dévisse), Egypt in the hellenistic era, ch.6 (General History of Africa II) (1981)
S. Donadoni, Egypt under Roman domination, ch.7 (General History of Africa II) (1981)

properties.basis: Dodecaschoenus (Aswan–Hiera Sycaminos) held by the Ptolemies but contested by Meroe (GHA II p.208); Ergamenes' temple at Dakka (p.203); Ptolemy VI colonies in the Triacontaschoenus (p.288). Shown as a point at Hiera Sycaminos (existing anchor, extents_historic.json), not a polygon.
